note: #2779 scenario 7 — the F1 safety inversion. Healthy charge, cool machine.
Charge drops below the operator's floor. The battery governor pauses the run.

Now the machine warms to `fair` while STILL below the floor, and tier 2's duty cycle engages on top of a live battery pause. The duty cycle writes pause:false to the same file. The battery pause must SURVIVE that — gating the battery governor's stand-down on `is_pacing` (which covers the duty cycle) instead of `is_pausing` (a genuine pause) is what let a run keep working, on battery, below the floor, all the way toward 0%.
